tenderSchedule.locationName: HGML Sr Manager Met Section Hutti

generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The payment and validity period in technical bid B & D should be same.
The document submitted by bidder in KPP Portal shall not be in corrupted/damaged/protected format.
If price bid is submitted in technical bid, then EMD will be FORFEITED and your offer will be REJECTED.
Bidder shall give undertaking that they have accepted our terms regarding Delivery/Completion, Validity & Payment as per format enclosed.
Bidders shall upload all the Documents in PDF format only.

As per the Government Orders vide FD 417 EXP-12-2024 dated: 09-08-2024, the bidder shall quote his rates exclusive of GST and inclusive of all Other applicable taxes, levies, duties, Cess etc. in the Kppp portal dashboard.
All other terms and conditions as per the NIT.

technicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer must have experience in carrying out underground Mine development work in any metal mines.

The Tenderer must have completed at least one underground mine development work in any one of the last five years (2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25, 2025-26). They should submit relevant work orders for the above.
The tenderer must have adequate skill, experience and facilities for executing the type of work herein contained and for which they shall be tendering.

The bidder in any one of the last five financial years (2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25) should have achieved in at least one Financial year, the turnover per annum not less than Rs. 2.0 Cr. The turnover certificate, to this effect, issued by the Chartered Accountant shall be enclosed.

The employees of the Company and their dependents/relatives are debarred from Offering the bids/submitting the tender either directly or indirectly. A declaration to this effect shall be submitted along with the offer.
Copies of Income Tax Returns for each of the FY 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25 to be submitted.
The Tenderer should enclose certified copy of Valid PF registration number allocated by the PF authorities.

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Annual Turnover Certificate, Profit & Loss statement and Balance sheet issued by the chartered Accountant for the year FY 2020-21, 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Copies of ITR for the last three years i.e. FY 2022-23, 2023-24 & 2024-25
Duly filled technical bid B should be attached in Technical Bid and format can be downloaded from enclosure
Undertaking as per Technical D should be attached and document can be downloaded from enclosures.
Copies of Purchase Order/Completion Certificate/Satisfactory report as a proof for past experience
Detailed scheme for executing the work along with type and number of equipment, the Tenderer proposes to deploy as per Annexure-I.

Organization chart giving details of field management at site, the Tenderer proposes to have for this job. Total number of statutorily qualified persons e.g., Underground Manager, Mine Foreman, Mining Mate, Blasters along with qualified Engineers etc. going to be deployed by the Tenderer as per Annexure - II.
Details of work experience in respect of the type of job in the tendered pro-forma as per Annexure - III and performance certificate thereof including all the requirements asked in 1.4 at NIT
Solvency certificate from Nationalized Bank to prove financial ability to carry out the work tendered for and other details required in Annexure-IV to evaluate financial status of the Tenderer.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Construction of RCC lining at 2700 L in Underground

itemList.description:
Construction of minimum 200 mm thick M20 RCC lining in the
underground Crusher Chamber at 2700L level, including rock scaling,
supporting, plug-hole drilling, cutting, bending, fixing and binding of steel
reinforcement rods, formwork, concreting, vibration, curing,
staging/platform arrangements, material handling and all incidental works
complete as per specifications- As per NIT.
